div.div: مِضْيَاقٌ , (JK, and O on the authority of Ibn- 'Abbád, and TA,) or ↓ ضِيَاقٌ , like كِتَابٌ [in measure], thus in all the copies of the K, (TA,) [but probably, I think, taken from a mistranscription,] A pessary (دُرْجَةٌ) of rag and perfume, with which a woman endeavours to constrict her vagina (تَسْتَضِيقُ بِهَا). (JK, Ibn-'Abbád, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
